value.rationale: Natural size-resolved part counts in random compositions are constrained by their total. A complete all-dimension inverse covariance classification distinguishes negligible marginal covariance of singleton/doubleton counts at two coordinates from a uniform strict negative Gaussian partial dependence upon observing more lengths. The -1 fixed-pair limit shows an extremal conditional-dependence phenomenon beyond an unmotivated finite table or the basic Gaussian convergence itself.
